user.title: SmartThings Find
user.description:
**How to extract the cookie**
1) Sign in at https://smartthingsfind.samsung.com
2) DevTools (F12) → Network
3) Select chkLogin.do (refresh if needed)
4) Request Headers → Cookie: copy the full line

⚠️ Close the SmartThings Find tab after copying to reduce session conflicts.

**Mode**
- Passive: read last cached server location (lower battery impact)
- Active: request a location update first (fresher, higher battery impact)
